definitions.explanation: Describes someone who has a high level of skill or ability in something. Often used to compliment someone's ability in language, sports, cooking, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上手|じょうず}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
{上手|じょうず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}せる→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to be able to speak well.
examples.notes: Using 上手に as an adverb

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上手|じょうず}な⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{音楽会|おんがくかい}→音楽会：11498_ongakukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My friend is good at piano, so they often perform at concerts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上手|じょうず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}って→通う：01217_kayou⟧、⟦いろいろな→色々：02352_iroiro⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}っています→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I want to become good at cooking, so I go to cooking class every week and learn various dishes.

notes:
{上手|じょうず} is a na-adjective meaning skillful or good at something.

GRAMMATICAL FORMS:
- Predicative: ～が{上手|じょうず}です (to be good at ~)
- Attributive: {上手|じょうず}な + noun ({上手|じょうず}な⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧, skillful driving)
- Adverbial: {上手|じょうず}に + verb ({上手|じょうず}に⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧, to speak well)
- Noun form: ⟦{上手|じょうず}さ→上手さ：noentry⟧ (skillfulness)

KEY PATTERN:
～が{上手|じょうず}です: "good at ~"
- ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧が{上手|じょうず}です (good at Japanese)
- ⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧が{上手|じょうず}です (good at singing)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {上手|じょうず}に⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become good at
- {上手|じょうず}く⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ ({上手|うま}く{行|い}く is more common): to go well
- ⟦{聞|き}き{上手|じょうず}→聞き上手：08468_kikijouzu⟧: good listener
- ⟦{話|はなし}{上手|じょうず}→話し上手：08467_hanashijouzu⟧: good talker

RELATED:
- ⟦{下手|へた}→下手：00703_heta⟧: unskillful, bad at (opposite)
- ⟦{上手|うま}い→うまい：01279_umai⟧: skillful, good at (more casual/colloquial)
- ⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧: strong point, specialty
